newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: PDVSA launches third marginal field auctions.
newsitem.headline: PDVSA launches third marginal field auctions.

text.p: Venezuelan Energy and Mines Minister Erwin Arrieta formally announced Friday the launch of a third round of marginal oil field auctions by state-run Petroleos de Venezuela (PDVSA).
Under the scheme, 20 fields will be auctioned.
Arrieta said they contained about 3,000 wells, of which some 700 are in production, with total reserves estimated at three billion barrels of crude.
"This is definitely an improvement on previous rounds," Arrieta told a news conference to present the third round.

Marginal fields' auctions started in 1992 and PDVSA expects to produce 430,000 barrels per day from them from the year 2000. This forms part of ambitious plans to boost Venezuela's oil output to six million bpd by 2005.

The areas auctioned are located in the Eastern and Western Venezuelan basins. They are: Intercampo N, Bachaquero S.O., Cretacico S, Mene Grande, La Concepcion, Ambrosio, Cabimas, LL- 652, B-2X.68/79, B-2-X.70/80, La Vela Costa Afuera, Mata, Caracoles, Maulpa, Kaki, Dacion, Onado, Boqueron, Acema and Casma Anaco.
